  301   def refresh_hp
  302     @hpNumbers.bitmap.clear
  303     return if !@battler.pokemon
  304     # Show HP numbers
  305     if @show_hp_numbers
  306       pbDrawNumber(self.hp, @hpNumbers.bitmap, 54, 2, :right)
  307       pbDrawNumber(-1, @hpNumbers.bitmap, 54, 2)   # / char
  308       pbDrawNumber(@battler.totalhp, @hpNumbers.bitmap, 70, 2)
  309     end
  310     # Resize HP bar
  311     w = 0
  312     if self.hp > 0
  313       w = @hpBarBitmap.width.to_f * self.hp / @battler.totalhp
  314       w = 1 if w < 1
  315       # NOTE: The line below snaps the bar's width to the nearest 2 pixels, to
  316       #       fit in with the rest of the graphics which are doubled in size.
  317       w = ((w / 2.0).round) * 2
  318     end
  319     @hpBar.src_rect.width = w
  320     hpColor = 0                                      # Green bar
  321     hpColor = 1 if self.hp <= @battler.totalhp / 2   # Yellow bar
  322     hpColor = 2 if self.hp <= @battler.totalhp / 4   # Red bar
  323     @hpBar.src_rect.y = hpColor * @hpBarBitmap.height / 3
  324   end
